content:
Potential alternative to current Sortie Rescue mission - instant execution
Currently, the thing that makes Sortie Rescue harder than normal Rescue, other than level and modifier of course, is the fact that entering the room triggers the execution sequence, so you have to rush to rescue the hostage. The issue is, I barely notice it's a thing, since I always just speedrun it so I rush to save the hostage anyway. It's not any extra trouble.

I have an alternative in the same vein that would make Sortie Rescue much more involved, rather than just a speedrun mission. Instead of the execution sequence going off immediately, what if the target was immediately executed once wardens trigger the alarms?

This change would make a more stealthy and focused gameplay necessary. Instead of just plowing through anyone in your way, you have to be more methodical about avoiding or stealthily killing wardens.

I understand some issues with this change. First of all, the sudden change will catch a lot of people off guard, but further than that, it could cause issues with some players being able to sabotage the group's efforts, but to be fair that can already happen in Spy. Another issue could be the Radiation Hazard effect. If an enemy walks into a rad bubble, other enemies will consider it their enemy, which could trigger wardens to trigger the execution even though you were never detected, so that would have to be fixed.

I'm not saying this is vastly superior to the current Rescue, or that it's something that really warrants a change, but nevertheless I had this idea while running Sorties and I thought it worth a discussion.
